usage: 炒蓮藕 is a noun referring to a specific vegetable dish made by stir-frying lotus root.
You can use 炒蓮藕 when ordering food at restaurants to specify this dish.
When describing dishes, 炒蓮藕 usually appears as the name of the dish without additional particles.
炒蓮藕 can be combined with quantity words, for example, 兩碟炒蓮藕 (two plates of stir-fried lotus root).
In conversations, 炒蓮藕 can also be used to ask about taste or ingredients, e.g., 你鍾唔鍾意炒蓮藕？
